liquidity.notes: USDT escrowed across 88 fiat markets (up to 100 ads per market, 5-page adaptive depth).

volume_30d_usd.notes: Binance does not separately disclose P2P volume

assumptions.match_rule: best-priced ad accepting a $1000 single tx with ≥$1000 USDT-side capacity
assumptions.fiat_fee: P2P payment methods carry no venue fiat fee
assumptions.trade_fee: flat taker fee per trade order on USDT pairs, 0.06–0.08 USDT depending on market (midpoint assumed) since 2025-09-22 — we assume 0.07 USDT; the per-fiat maker fee is embedded in the quoted price
assumptions.transfer_out: USDT withdrawal to BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) (0.01 USDT; network-dependent: 0.01 (BEP20) to 1.5 (TRC20) USDT; ERC20 0.4, Solana 0.3; checked 2026-07-21) — optional exit to self-custody, excluded from total

assumptions.match_rule: median of the top-5 best-paying qualifying ads (outlier-resistant: best SELL prices are often reversible-payment risk premiums)
assumptions.fiat_fee: P2P payment methods carry no venue fiat fee
assumptions.trade_fee: flat taker fee per trade order on USDT pairs, 0.06–0.08 USDT depending on market (midpoint assumed) since 2025-09-22 — we assume 0.07 USDT; the per-fiat maker fee is embedded in the quoted price
assumptions.transfer_out: depositing USDT from chain costs network gas only; the venue charges nothing — excluded from total

cost_1k.notes: Spread legs are live $1k single-match quotes vs the CoinGecko FX mid; the optional exit-to-chain line uses Binance’s published withdrawal schedule (hand-checked).

markets.notes: Top 10 deepest markets (by USDT depth in top-20 ad slice), filtered to those with FX mids available.

depth_composition.notes: Per-fiat share of USDT escrow observed in the top-20 BUY ad slice across 88 fiat markets. Snapshot, not a window — Binance doesn't publish historical volume.

network_health.notes: Maker-reputation aggregates across distinct advertisers seen in the top-20 slice of every probed market. Snapshot of currently-posting makers, not a 30d window.
